name: Sushi
hook: Rice, seaweed and the fish names — the six things most sushi clues actually test.

facts.label: vinegared rice
facts.statement: Sushi is vinegared rice — hosomaki and futomaki are roll types — while the raw fish alone is called sashimi.

facts.label: nori
facts.statement: Nori is the dried seaweed, actually a red alga, sold in sheets to wrap sushi.

facts.label: wasabi
facts.statement: Wasabi is the hot green sushi condiment; the green paste commonly served is horseradish.

facts.label: gari
facts.statement: Gari is pickled ginger, eaten between pieces of sushi to cleanse the palate.

facts.label: California roll
facts.statement: The California roll was created in Los Angeles by Ichiro Mashita, substituting avocado and crab for tuna.

facts.label: toro
facts.statement: Toro is the fatty belly of tuna, the most valuable cut at a sushi bar.

facts.label: hamachi
facts.statement: Hamachi is yellowtail; the same fish is called inada or buri depending on its age and size.
